lessons.impact: Contracts must require sourceDocumentId, sourceDocumentVersion, and sourceFingerprint on source-derived package artifacts; evidence freshness must be recalculated when fingerprints change.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Promote fingerprint freshness from extraction note to package validation contract.

lessons.impact: Extraction artifacts cannot be executable authority until reviewed decisions are recorded separately.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Add decision-record requirement for source ambiguities and prototype-only behavior.

lessons.impact: Package readiness must be scoped by current slice; future-slice blockers must not block current-slice integration unless advertised as supported.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Define current-slice readiness and exclusion metadata.

lessons.impact: Catalogs may be partial while current-slice fields remain valid; package contracts need enabled/disabled/candidate item states.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Specify catalog item lifecycle and advertised support boundaries.

lessons.impact: Open issues can coexist with prototype integration, but must block promotion/publication where relevant.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Add issue/blocker ledger contract and promotion impact field.

lessons.impact: Reference validation must include executable suites, fixtures, reports, and environment fingerprints, not just checklist prose.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Add executable test harness/report requirements for package promotion.

lessons.impact: Rule Set package security cannot remain an architectural principle only; runtime package-root isolation and no-network constraints need enforceable gates.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Add runtime enforcement contract to RFC-0027/SPEC-0001.

lessons.impact: Localization is not optional presentation garnish for Rule Sets; missing keys can affect package readiness and tests.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Add localization key coverage and identity-stability validation.

lessons.impact: Review evidence needs freshness checks against source and artifact fingerprints.
Package review requires reconciliation among catalogs, fixtures, tests, localization, security, and evidence, not isolated document approval.
Promotion gates prove eligibility to move artifacts into package surface; publication requires separate packaging/release/legal readiness.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Separate promotionReady from runtimePublicationReady in normative lifecycle.

lessons.lesson: declarative prototype versus executable Rule Set package
lessons.impact: The docs prototype is not yet the compiled package implementation; repository materialization must not create application source projects until contracts are reconciled.
lessons.requiredDocumentChange: Define materialization prerequisites and package source topology.
